integrityRecord.numericPortTreatment: TWO numeric worked examples ported verbatim from the source Calculation sections. Energetics Calculations: 100 x 4.18 x 7.5 = 3135 J, negative sign applied for the exothermic rise, then -3135 ÷ 1000 = -3.135 kJ — the source quotes -3.14 kJ at 3 s.f., but -3.135 is a half-rounding boundary the floating-point scanner cannot re-verify, so the port restated the conversion at 4 s.f. and added an explicit rounding sentence carrying the source's -3.14 kJ (3 s.f.) as a stated value; every number in the final answer traces to a stated step value. Bond Energy: 436 + 242 = 678; 2 x 431 = 862; 678 - 862 = -184 kJ, all exact integers. COPY-IT RED LINE HELD: no number invented, no step rewritten to manufacture parseable arithmetic — the arithmetic was already in the source; steps read expression-first with single-equals lines per the scanner-crash treatment documented since wave-3.
